Product Manager – Checkout & Payments
Northwind Commerce · Bengaluru, India (Hybrid – 3 days a week in office)

About the role
Northwind Commerce runs an online marketplace used by 4 million shoppers. We are looking for a Product Manager to own the checkout and payments experience. You will work with a cross-functional squad of six engineers, a designer and a data analyst to reduce checkout drop-off and launch new payment methods.

What you will do
- Own the checkout roadmap and prioritise the backlog with the engineering lead.
- Run discovery with customers and turn insights into clear product requirements and user stories.
- Design and analyse A/B tests to improve conversion.
- Work with stakeholders in finance, legal and customer support to launch new payment methods.
- Define success metrics and report progress to leadership every month.

What you need (required)
- 3–5 years of experience in product management, or in a closely related role such as business analysis with strong product exposure.
- Proven experience writing product requirements and user stories in Jira or a similar tool.
- Strong analytical skills, including SQL, to answer your own data questions.
- Hands-on experience running A/B tests or other experiments.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Nice to have
- Experience with payments, fintech or e-commerce checkout.
- Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Amplitude or Mixpanel.
- Experience working with design tools like Figma.

You should also be comfortable with ambiguity and able to wear many hats in a fast-paced environment.

What we offer
Competitive salary, health insurance for you and your family, a learning budget and flexible working hours. Northwind Commerce is an equal opportunity employer.
